Name: (CP) Wooden Mushroom Boxes
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[size=4][b][b][size=4]Updated for 1.6![/size][/b][/b][/size][font=Tahoma]

So I started a new file with a mushroom cave, only to realize how drab the mushroom boxes were. This mod dresses them up with a nicer wood finish~

This comes with two options--[b]Vanilla Wood,[/b] matching the wood colors of the vanilla craftables; and [b]Burnt Sienna Wood, [/b]matching the wood of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1877]Burnt Sienna Wood and Gold Craftables.[/url] If people like these, I may come up with more wood variations in the future~

--

[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url] or program of your choice) to choose your desired color (default is Burnt Sienna). Alternatively, use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make your choice in-game.﻿
4. Load up your game and enjoy!

[/font]--
Original Content Patcher versions--separate versions thanks to [color=#f1f1f1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/171827]m2pt5[/url], and a config version thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/27024274]pepoluan[/url]! [/color]
